Mira (marketing): quick spot check for Friday deck  dash shows launch-post CTR +34% but MQLs look down vs last week. Can someone triage? https://dash.redwood/board/launch-snaps :mag:
Jon (growth): which step? click->reg or reg->mql?
Mira (marketing): reg->mql. regs steady but qualified dropped 26% in the 7d window.
Rita (analytics): running a fast cohort split. Initial: small enrichment gap around 04/09 03:20-03:50 UTC. dashbot flagged `enrichment-timeout`.
Dev (ops): saw a spike in enrichment latency then, increased retries and processed backlog. Incident INC-2024-3201 open.
dashbot: note reprocess recommended for affected window.
Jon (growth): ok hold headline until Rita reprocesses. Also flag if attribution fallback to last-touch occurred.
Rita (analytics): kicked reproc job `reproc_20240409_0355`. ETA 8m. will post recovered counts and small CSV.
Mira (marketing): thanks. if reproc restores numbers we annotate slide: "corrected post-reprocessing (enrichment timeout)."
Rita (analytics): reproc done  output: pre=94 MQLs, post=128 MQLs. recovered_utm=22, crm_merge=1. CSV: https://internal.jobs/reproc_20240409_0355/export.csv
Dev (ops): mitigation: increased enrichment timeout and added alert `enrichment_retries > 3` in 5m. Scheduling 30m postmortem with analytics.
Mira (marketing): perfect. I'll use conservative last-touch headline and add a one-line footnote + appendix with time-decay sensitivity. Sending deck after I attach the CSV. :raised_hands:
